+++unsupported/extension
opaque [* extension] payload
+++
+++fallback
Show [* this] instead
+++

assertions: extension openers attach the extension name directly to the `+++` fence
`+++fallback` immediately after an extension block provides fallback content
fallback content is parsed as ordinary &ND blocks
